description: Source file implementing various null sink classes for F1-U and F1-C bearers, including disconnect functions that connect to null bearers, used in a 3GPP-related telecom project.

classes.name: null_sink_f1c_bearer
classes.description: A null implementation of f1c_bearer that discards all PDU handling.

classes.name: null_sink_f1u_bearer
classes.description: A null implementation of f1u_bearer and related handler interfaces that discards all events.

classes.name: null_sink_rlc_bearer
classes.description: A null implementation of RLC bearer interfaces that discards all SDUs and PDUs.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_delivery
methods.description: Handles a PDU and returns a no-op async task indicating success.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnect method that connects to the respective null bearer.
